Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8352); Seth (i.e. Sheth), a patriarch:--Seth.
BiblicalUsage: Seth is the son of Adam, named in the genealogy of Jesus: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God. He is the seed God gave after Abel, and the line of the promise runs through him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Seth is the beginning of the godly line: after Abel's murder, God gave another seed, and the line runs from him to Jesus.
